info.name: Buildiq Automation Approval Steps Contract
info.description:
Newman/Postman contract suite for the automation-approval-steps change (task 6.2). Covers: (1) AutomationsController::status() surfaces `approvalState` (spec REQ-AUTD-007 task 5.1); (2) POST .../dry-run surfaces `approvalState` alongside the would-be-actions result and creates no real ApprovalStep (task 5.2); (3) OpenRegister's `/api/approval-steps` list endpoint is reachable and reflects the group-based `role` filter the My Approvals widget relies on (task 4.1); (4) no Buildiq pass-through route exists for approve/reject — `/apps/buildiq/api/approval-steps/{id}/approve` 404s, proving the widget calls OpenRegister directly (task 4.2, ADR-022 redundant-controller gate).

SETUP PRECONDITION: requires a seeded `automation` object (buildiq register) with trigger `{type: object-created, schema: <seeded-schema>}` and one `approval` action assigned to a group the `adminUser` account belongs to, already compiled (POST .../compile called once so `provenance.approvalChainName` is set) — set `automationUuid` accordingly. Skips gracefully (logs a note, does not fail) when `automationUuid` is left at its placeholder default, so a stock/unseeded instance does not produce a false failure.

Run via run-newman.sh. NOT executed in this session (no deploy to the shared dev instance per project policy) — written for CI, mirrors the existing collections' convention of asserting shape/contract rather than requiring bespoke fixture data beyond what's documented above.
